messages:
incident-bot: ⚠️ ALERT: Customer PrimePay (tenant: primepay-prod) — eu-west-1 dedicated GPU pool showing sustained p99 latency > 1.2s for the last 6 minutes. Route: /v1/generate. Current p95 340ms, p99 1.62s. Relevant pool: ded-pool-eu-3. Paging oncall.
alex_chang: ack — oncall. Jumping in. any known deploys right now?
priya_kumar: i didn't see any deploys in the window. Monitoring shows a spike in queue length for ded-pool-eu-3: queue depth ~480 (norm 40). CPU/GPU exec looks saturated on 8 of 12 instances.
sre_lisa: tagging @sam_custeng (Customer Eng) and @infra_max. Sam — are they on a pinned model variant? Could fallback to a smaller variant while we mitigate.
sam_custeng: PrimePay on a dedicated plan, pinned to rwd-llama-v2-14b-q4 at version v2026-11-03. They explicitly asked not to roll forward without approval. They did request higher throughput earlier this month.
infra_max: gathering GPU metrics. Looks like one node has a runaway process causing high memory and blocking others. I'll tail logs.
infra_max: (logs) "OOMError: allocation failed" on instance i-0a1b2c3 — restarting container.
deploy-bot: deploy-event: container restart triggered on host i-0a1b2c3 by infra_max — image: rwd-runtime:2026-11-02.
alex_chang: good. Restart should free capacity, but queue is still growing. We need short-term traffic controls. Suggestions: reduce batch size for primepay route, enable fallback to rwd-llama-v2-7b-q4, or divert to hosted pool if contractual allowed.
priya_kumar: config change: can set per-route max_batch_tokens to 512 from 2048. That will reduce latency at cost of throughput. I can flip it if approved.
sam_custeng: we can fallback to 7b for non-SLA-critical endpoints. PrimePay legal said core payments lint must stay on 14b. We need tenant isolation — maybe route non-critical routes to fallback.
eng_jun: propose playbook: 1) isolate tenant queue (move primepay to isolation queue), 2) scale ded-pool-eu-3 by +4 nodes (hot add), 3) set batch limit to 512 for primepay's /v1/generate, 4) enable soft-fallback for non-critical endpoints to 7b. I'll run commands if infra_max gives go.
infra_max: running: redwoodctl pools scale --pool ded-pool-eu-3 --add 4
infra_max: scale request accepted. New nodes provisioning — expected ready ~6m. provisioning logs: node-provisioner: spawned i-0d4e5f6, i-0d4e5f7, i-0d4e5f8, i-0d4e5f9.
priya_kumar: applying per-route change: redwoodctl routes update --tenant primepay-prod --route /v1/generate --max-batch-tokens 512
priya_kumar: done. config pushed. watch latency.
alex_chang: enabling soft fallback for primes that are not flagged critical: redwoodctl routes update --tenant primepay-prod --route /v1/generate --fallback-model rwd-llama-v2-7b-q4 --fallback-policy soft
alex_chang: done. Note: non-deterministic outputs may change slightly.
sre_lisa: after batch limit and fallback, p99 dropped to 980ms (from 1.62s). queue depth down to 220.
sam_custeng: notifying customer: "We observed a temporary performance degradation in your dedicated pool in eu-west. We've isolated your queue and applied mitigations; core payment paths remain on your pinned model. We'll follow up with postmortem and capacity plan." Any objections?
pm_ella: please include ETA for full recovery and whether there's data loss risk. Also ask customer if they accept a scheduled capacity bump to avoid future saturations.
sam_custeng: sending note to PrimePay now. message: "Hi — we're responding to a latency spike. We've isolated your traffic and applied mitigations that preserve core workflows on your pinned model. Expect reduced latency in <10m. We'll provide root cause and next steps shortly. —Sam"
deploy-bot: incident-note: customer-notified by sam_custeng at 1808320620.
infra_max: new nodes ready and joined cluster. Pool capacity increased. Observed GPU utilization dropping from 92% to 58%.
eng_jun: recommend keeping new nodes for 24h and schedule an on-call review for autoscaling thresholds. Also propose increasing reserved capacity for primepay by +20% on next billing cycle.
priya_kumar: rolling back batch limit change? leaving it for now until load normalizes. I'll monitor.
alex_chang: handoff to night oncall @sre_lisa in 8m. summary for handoff: PrimePay eu-west p99 spike due to one host OOM + high queue; mitigations: restarted host, scaled pool +4 nodes, set per-route batch limit 512, enabled soft fallback to 7b for non-critical paths. Customer notified. Current state: p95 210ms, p99 420ms, queue depth 35. No errors in user-facing logs.
sre_lisa: taking it. I'll run through escalation checklist and keep customer in the loop. If p99 > 800ms again, escalate to eng_jun and infra_max immediately. posting handoff log to oncall doc.
alex_chang: thx. adding notes to incident tracker: incident/ref 2026-11-primepay-dedpool-180832.
incident-bot: reminder: create postmortem within 72h if customer SLA impacted. P99 breach >15m flagged.
sre_lisa: ack. starting a short RCA thread now. tagging eng_jun and infra_max. closing war room here, but keeping thread pinned."
